story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
**AC-1: Color Palette Consistency** - Primary colors match design system (Apple Liquid Glass tokens) - Secondary and accent colors consistent across components - Status colors uniform (success, error, warning, info) - Background colors consistent (card, page, modal backgrounds) - Text colors follow hierarchy (primary, secondary, muted)
**AC-2: Typography Consistency** - Font families (system fonts or defined web fonts) - Heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3, no skips) - Font sizes matching design system scale - Font weights consistent (regular, medium, semibold, bold) - Line heights appropriate for readability - Letter spacing consistent where applicable
**AC-3: Spacing Consistency** - Component padding uses standardized values (8px, 16px, 24px, 32px) - Component margin uses standardized values - Gap between elements consistent - Section spacing uniform - Card spacing consistent - Follows 4px/8px grid system
**AC-4: Component Styles Consistency** - Button styles (primary, secondary, ghost, destructive variants) - Border radius on all components (buttons, cards, inputs, modals) - Shadow depths matching elevation levels (subtle, medium, large) - Input field styles (normal, focus, error, disabled states) - Loading states (skeleton screens, spinners) - Empty states (messaging and illustrations) - Error states (formatting and display)
**AC-5: Navigation Consistency** - Sidebar menu styling across all pages - Active page indicator clear and consistent - Breadcrumbs styling (if applicable) - Page headers layout uniform - Navigation transitions smooth
**AC-6: Responsive Behavior** - All pages work on mobile (320px, 375px, 414px) - All pages work on tablet (768px, 1024px) - All pages work on desktop (1280px, 1920px) - No horizontal scroll on any breakpoint - Touch targets min 44x44px on mobile - Content reflows appropriately
**AC-7: Focus States and Interactive Elements** - Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements - Focus indicator style consistent (outline or ring) - Tab order logical and predictable - Focus trapping works in modals/dialogs - Skip-to-content link present
**AC-8: Documentation and Audit Results** - Audit checklist completed with findings - Spreadsheet documenting all inconsistencies found - Before/after screenshots for major fixes - Updated design system documentation (optional) - List of tailwind.config.ts updates made

artifacts.docs:
### Architecture Documents
**Design System Foundation** (from architecture.md): The Next.js UI implements Apple Liquid Glass design system with: - Glassmorphism: backdrop-filter blur, subtle shadows, transparency - Modern system fonts: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI - Color palette from design-tokens.json - Dark mode support via next-themes - Responsive breakpoints: mobile (< 768px), tablet (768-1024px), desktop (> 1024px)
**Epic Context - Story 5.1 Details** (from epics-nextjs-ui-migration.md lines 1436-1490): This story is Story 5.1 in Epic 5: UI/UX Consistency & Cleanup.
Key Requirements: 1. Color palette matches design system (Apple Liquid Glass tokens from design-tokens.json) 2. Typography hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3, no skips), sizes, weights from design tokens 3. Spacing follows 4px/8px grid system (defined in design tokens) 4. Border radius, shadow depths consistent across cards, buttons, inputs 5. Loading states (skeleton screens, spinners), empty states, error states consistent 6. Navigation (sidebar, active page, breadcrumbs, page headers) uniform 7. Responsive: works on all breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px)
**Audit Approach**: - Create audit checklist (colors, typography, spacing, etc.) - Use browser dev tools for responsive testing - Document inconsistencies in spreadsheet - Fix inconsistencies by updating Tailwind classes - Test responsive behavior on all breakpoints - Run build to ensure no errors
**Related Epics**: - Epic 5 Story 5.2: Accessibility (A11y) Compliance - WCAG 2.1 AA - Epic 5 Story 5.3: Loading States & Error Handling Consistency - Epic 5 Story 5.4: Remove Unnecessary Pages & Cleanup
**Prerequisites**: All pages implemented (Epics 1-4 complete)
artifacts.code:
### Design System Configuration
**Tailwind Config** (nextjs-ui/tailwind.config.ts): ```typescript // Design tokens imported from: ../docs/design-system/design-tokens.json // Extended theme includes: - colors: extractTokenValues(designTokens.colors) - fontFamily: primary fonts from design tokens - fontSize: design token font scale - spacing: design token spacing scale - borderRadius: design token radius values - blur: glassmorphism blur effects - boxShadow: elevation shadow levels - transitionDuration: animation durations (fast, base, slow, very-slow) - transitionTimingFunction: easing functions - animation: elastic-bounce-in, ambient-sway, mesh-gradient-shift, etc. - screens: breakpoints from design tokens ```
**UI Components** (nextjs-ui/components/ui/): Core primitive components that need consistency audit: - Button.tsx - 5 variants (primary, secondary, ghost, destructive, disabled) - Card.tsx - glassmorphic cards with backdrop-filter - Input.tsx - input fields with states (normal, focus, error, disabled) - Modal.tsx - dialog/modal overlays - Toast.tsx - notification system (using Sonner) - Badge.tsx - status badges - Loading.tsx - loading spinners - Skeleton.tsx, SkeletonCard.tsx, SkeletonTable.tsx - skeleton screens - EmptyState.tsx - empty state displays - Table.tsx - data tables - Tabs.tsx - tab navigation - Select.tsx - dropdown selects - Tooltip.tsx - hover tooltips - ConfirmDialog.tsx - confirmation dialogs - Accordion.tsx - collapsible sections
**Root Layout** (nextjs-ui/app/layout.tsx): Provider hierarchy (important for theming): 1. MSWProvider - Mock Service Worker 2. SessionProvider - Authentication state 3. ReactQueryProvider - Server state management 4. ThemeProvider - Light/dark mode (next-themes) 5. ToastProvider - Notifications (Sonner) 6. KeyboardShortcutsProvider - Command palette
**Dashboard Pages** (to audit): From the epic, these pages exist and need audit: - Dashboard: /dashboard - Agent Performance: /performance - LLM Costs: /costs - Workers: /workers - Tenants: /tenants, /tenants/[id], /tenants/new - Agents: /agents, /agents/[id], /agents/new, /agents/[id]/test - LLM Providers: /llm-providers, /llm-providers/[id], /llm-providers/new - MCP Servers: /mcp-servers, /mcp-servers/[id], /mcp-servers/new - Queue Management: /operations - Execution History: /execution-history - Audit Logs: /audit-logs - Plugins: /plugins, /plugins/[id], /plugins/new - System Prompts: /prompts, /prompts/[id] - Add Tool: /tools

story-context.constraints:
### Technical Constraints
1. **Design Token Source**: ALL design values must come from design-tokens.json (no hardcoded values) 2. **Tailwind Only**: Use Tailwind utility classes exclusively (no inline styles, no CSS modules) 3. **Glass Effects**: Glassmorphism requires backdrop-filter support (provide fallback for unsupported browsers) 4. **Responsive Grid**: All spacing must align to 4px/8px grid system 5. **Dark Mode**: All components must support both light and dark themes 6. **Accessibility**: All interactive elements need visible focus indicators (WCAG 2.1 AA) 7. **Performance**: No layout shift (CLS), animations respect prefers-reduced-motion 8. **Browser Support**: Chrome 120+, Firefox 120+, Safari 17+, Edge 120+
### Business Constraints
1. **No Breaking Changes**: Audit and fixes must not break existing functionality 2. **Backward Compatibility**: All pages must continue to work during audit 3. **Testing Required**: Build must pass after all fixes 4. **Documentation**: Document all tailwind.config.ts updates made 5. **User Experience**: Users should not notice audit work (no downtime)

tests.standards:
### Testing Standards for This Story
**AC Verification Tests**: 1. Visual regression: Chromatic snapshots of all pages (before/after) 2. Component tests: All UI primitives tested in Storybook 3. Responsive tests: Screenshot testing at all breakpoints (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px) 4. Build test: `npm run build` must pass without TypeScript/ESLint errors 5. Dark mode test: Toggle dark mode, verify all pages still readable 6. Focus indicator test: Tab through all pages, verify focus visible
**Acceptance Criteria Test Plan**: - AC-1 (Colors): Compare all colors used vs design-tokens.json, verify match - AC-2 (Typography): Check heading hierarchy on 5 sample pages, verify h1 → h2 → h3 - AC-3 (Spacing): Measure padding/margin on 10 components, verify 4px/8px multiples - AC-4 (Components): Audit 10+ components for style consistency (buttons, cards, inputs) - AC-5 (Navigation): Check sidebar, breadcrumbs, headers on all pages - AC-6 (Responsive): Test all pages on mobile (iPhone 13), tablet (iPad), desktop - AC-7 (Focus): Tab through all pages, verify focus indicator visible and consistent - AC-8 (Docs): Verify audit spreadsheet completed, screenshots captured

### Test File Locations
**Component Tests**: - nextjs-ui/__tests__/components/ui/*.test.tsx - Existing tests: Button, Card, Input, Modal, Loading, Badge, Tabs, Toast, Tooltip, ThemeToggle
**Storybook Stories**: - nextjs-ui/components/ui/*.stories.tsx - All UI primitives have Storybook stories for visual testing
**E2E Tests** (if needed): - nextjs-ui/__tests__/e2e/*.spec.ts - Playwright for critical user flows
**Build Test**: ```bash cd nextjs-ui && npm run build # Must pass with 0 TypeScript errors, 0 ESLint errors ```
**Visual Regression**: - Use Chromatic with Storybook - Capture snapshots before/after audit fixes - Compare for unintended changes

tests.ideas:
### Testing Ideas and Approaches
**Automated Audit Ideas**: 1. **Color Extraction Script**: Write Node.js script to extract all color values from .tsx files, compare against design-tokens.json 2. **Typography Scanner**: Grep for h1, h2, h3 tags, verify hierarchy on each page 3. **Spacing Analyzer**: Extract all padding/margin values, flag non-4px/8px multiples 4. **Component Consistency Checker**: Parse all Button/Card/Input usages, verify props match
**Manual Audit Workflow**: 1. Open Chrome DevTools 2. Set viewport to each breakpoint (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1920px) 3. Screenshot each page at each breakpoint 4. Measure padding/margins with DevTools ruler 5. Document findings in spreadsheet: - Page name - Issue type (color, typography, spacing, component) - Expected value (from design tokens) - Actual value (measured) - Fix applied (Tailwind class change) - Screenshot reference
**Visual Regression Approach**: 1. Before fixes: Run Storybook, capture Chromatic snapshots 2. Apply fixes 3. After fixes: Run Storybook again, capture new snapshots 4. Compare: Chromatic will highlight differences 5. Approve changes if intentional 6. Flag unexpected changes
**Responsive Testing Approach**: 1. Use Chrome DevTools responsive design mode 2. Test each page at breakpoints: 320px, 375px, 414px (mobile), 768px, 1024px (tablet), 1280px, 1920px (desktop) 3. Check for: - Horizontal scroll (should not exist) - Text overflow (should not exist) - Touch target size (min 44x44px on mobile) - Layout breaks (components should reflow, not break) 4. Document issues with screenshots 5. Fix by adjusting breakpoint-specific Tailwind classes (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:)
**Focus Indicator Testing**: 1. Start on login page 2. Press Tab key repeatedly 3. Verify focus indicator visible on: - Input fields (blue ring) - Buttons (blue ring) - Links (blue ring) - Dropdowns (blue ring) - Tabs (blue ring) - Modals (focus trapped inside) 3. Document any missing focus indicators 4. Fix by adding focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500 to elements
